name: Alex Chen
background: Alex is a first-generation Chinese-American who grew up in a small town in Ohio. He moved to the Bay Area after completing his master's degree at Stanford. He values innovation and work-life balance, enjoying hiking and photography in his free time. He identifies as politically moderate and is passionate about environmental sustainability.

name: Maria Santos
background: Maria immigrated from Cuba with her family when she was 12. She has been teaching for over 20 years and is deeply involved in her local community. She is a devout Catholic, married with three children, and values family traditions. She enjoys salsa dancing and cooking traditional Cuban recipes.

name: James Wilson
background: James served 30 years in the Army, retiring as a Colonel. He is now involved in veteran support organizations and mentoring young service members. He is conservative politically, a Protestant Christian, and values discipline and service. He enjoys golf, reading military history, and spending time with his grandchildren.

name: Aisha Patel
background: Aisha is a second-generation Indian-American who grew up in a multicultural household. She works at a major hospital system managing operations. She practices yoga and meditation, values work-life integration, and is passionate about improving healthcare accessibility. She identifies as Hindu but considers herself spiritual rather than strictly religious.

name: Tyler Brooks
background: Tyler is a creative professional who grew up in rural Oregon and moved to Portland for more opportunities. They are passionate about LGBTQ+ advocacy and environmental activism. They enjoy video games, digital art, and attending music festivals. They identify as politically progressive and are interested in sustainable fashion.
